vae.reason: Efficient stable convolutional latent baseline; reconstruction objective may blur fine texture.

gan.reason: Convolutional adversarial comparator targets sharper texture; monitor diversity and stability.

preprocessing.vae: reshape interleaved RGB to CHW; divide pixels by 255
preprocessing.gan: reshape interleaved RGB to CHW; divide pixels by 127.5 and subtract 1
preprocessing.rationale: Preserve RGB ordering and staining; fixed scaling requires no learned fit. Exclude sample_id and tissue_type.

rejected_alternatives.flow: Supplied image flow operates on truncated PCA representation, limiting fine tissue texture and full-image likelihood interpretation.
rejected_alternatives.diffusion: Iterative denoising and sampling cost on CPU; prioritize two cheaper complementary convolutional models rather than a shallow undertrained diffusion run.

evaluation_plan: visual synthetic grids versus real examples
8 color/texture means, pixel pairwise diversity, sampled training nearest neighbors
no held-out hyperparameter selection; VAE script computes eval loss each epoch but no checkpoint selection or early stopping
follow_up_rule: Only one small follow-up if a specific fix is supported; do not tune repeatedly on held-out metrics.

follow_up_decision.rationale: The planned GAN already addresses the observed VAE smoothing and improves texture and diversity. Residual grid artifacts and unverified morphology require architecture or domain evaluation capabilities beyond the permitted scripts; additional epochs or a small parameter tweak has no demonstrated remedy. Avoid repeated selection on evaluation data.
